Every run had exactly PATH=/usr/bin:/bin, HOME and LC_ALL=C/LANG=C as its environment. <tmp>/home holds a .gitconfig with the single helper `store`; <tmp>/empty-home holds nothing; <tmp>/plain is not a repository; <tmp>/healthy is a fresh `git init`; <tmp>/bad is a fresh `git init` whose .git/config then had the malformed line `[core` appended. Substitution, the only bytes rewritten: the scratch directory is spelled <tmp>. JSON escapes newlines as \n, so this file is ASCII.
